decisions.question: For an Unready case whose Next Purpose/Canonical Stage is N.B.W._Unready or B.W._Unready, should it always go to the N.B.W. / B.W. section regardless of case prefix, or should the case prefix rule continue to determine the section?

If a case is marked Ready but its Next Purpose corresponds to a stage that appears only in the Unready sections of the final board (for example Steps or Reply/Say), where should that case be listed? (A) A specific existing Ready-side row? (B) The relevant Unready section despite the Ready flag? (C) A new Ready-side row? (D) Another rule applies?
